description: Assemble two or more Sanger reads into a contig WITHOUT a reference sequence — the forward/reverse pair of one insert, or a set of tiling reads. Orientation is worked out from the overlaps, ends are quality-trimmed, and the consensus is quality-weighted. Reports depth and agreement per position, every position where the reads disagree (including a base only one read has), and any read that overlapped nothing. Use sanger_vs_reference instead when you already know what the sequence should be.

fasta.description: Alternative to `reads`: a multi-record FASTA of the reads. No quality, so no end trimming.

minIdentity.description: Lowest percent identity an overlap may have.

minOverlap.description: Shortest overlap that may join two reads.

noTrim.description: Assemble the reads exactly as given, with no quality trimming.

reads.description: The reads, as [{name, sequence, quality?}]. `quality` is a per-base Phred array the same length as `sequence`; without it the read still assembles but its ends are NOT trimmed, which the result says.

trimThreshold.description: Phred threshold for end-trimming. Ignored for reads with no quality array.

name: sanger_assemble
title: Sanger de novo assembly
